newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian team heads for Brussels succession talks.
newsitem.headline: Croatian team heads for Brussels succession talks.

text.p: A Croatian delegation is heading for Brussels for separate talks with international mediator Sir Arthur Watts, in charge of the succession of former Yugoslavia, a senior government official said on Friday.

Bozo Marendic, who heads a government office for succession issues, told Reuters he could not yet comment on reports that former Yugoslav republics might meet soon to discuss a division of pre-1991 Yugoslav assets.
Belgrade newspapers reported that joint talks could be convened as early as October.
